# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

What are others saying about our impact? With operations in 70 countries, Cargill and our customers

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

### We grow and process exceptional specialty oilseed crops to create awesomely functional
### ingredients.

[bee Circle.jpg]

#### Beyond sustainability.

Regenerative means putting back more than we take from nature & the earth. We are the first
specialty oils ingredient producer to commit to achieving a truly regenerative plant-based supply
chain from the ground up.

[hands circle.jpg]

#### It’s in our roots.

Our passion is growing & processing specialty oilseed crops into some truly amazing ingredients for
health & wellness. We built & manage our vertically integrated supply chain, giving complete
traceability & confidence of unbroken supply.

[Oildropcircle.jpg]

#### It’s what we do.

Our unrelenting focus is to deliver only superior-performing, plant-based oil ingredients backed by
science with unsurpassed quality—from the cleanest, greenest, most fully de-risked supply chain
available globally.

#### Feel well. Look well. Move well.

Whether taken as a nutritional product or applied topically, our functionally superior, high quality
natural ingredients let us help your customers feel well, look well and move well —whether they are
humans, horses, or dogs!

[ Learn more ][33]

#### Dedicated to Personal & Planetary Wellness Through Specialty Plant-Based Oils.

We’re not your typical specialty oils supplier. Every batch of completely pure, fully traceable
Natures Crops oil has been cultivated regeneratively by passionate & qualified growers using our
superior non-GMO varieties. We care deeply about your customers, your brand, & how using our
ingredients builds deeper wellness for people and the earth. Let us help your customers join the
plant-based revolution. 

[ Learn more ][34]
 
[iStock-172202755.jpg]

#### Crop Assured 365®

If you don’t know where your ingredients come from or how they were grown, how can you claim
sustainability? Crop Assured 365® is our proprietary process of 100% lot traceability, identity
preservation, & quality control. Our seal assures that our product is of the highest quality
available, grown from our selected, registered varieties. Our exacting process of stewardship
throughout the supply-chain ensures traceability back to the farm, full product records,
authenticity, no co-mingling, and a safe, uninterrupted supply-chain.

[CA365 copy.png]

#### We bring the cleanest, greenest & least-risk supply chain to your products. Every day.

You have many things in your business to worry about, but quality, safety, and availability of your
specialty ingredients shouldn’t be any of them! Our vertical integration, deep natural products
expertise, and our entire team’s passion to provide our customers unrivaled service and confidence
in our robust product supply chains, means you have a lot less to worry about.

[SupplyChain+green2.19.jpg]

[pTeroSol® Logo]
**pTeroSol^{®}**, a water-soluble, nature-inspired extract prepared from the heartwood of the Indian

[DigeZyme® Logo]

digestive enzymes: amylase, protease, lipase, cellulase, and lactase.

[Livinol® Logo]

Garcinol, which supports energy balance, liver health, and supports healthy weight maintenance with
diet and exercise.

[Tinofolin® Logo]

of the plant *Tinospora cordifolia* (Guduchi), standardized to 2.5% Bitter Principles.

[Sabroxy®]
[Sabroxy® Logo]

A patent protected, clinically evaluated standardized extract prepared from the dried bark of the
Indian trumpet tree (*Oroxylum indicum*), containing a minimum of 10% Oroxylin A, 15% Baicalein, 6%
Chrysin. It helps to support healthy cognitive function, memory, concentration, focus and neuronal
functions.

[CurCousin®]
[CurCousin® Logo]

CurCousin® is a branded nutritional ingredient containing the bioactive Calebin A (analog of
Curcumin) with self-affirmed GRAS status. It is a curcumin analog naturally present in *Curcuma
longa / cassia* (Black Turmeric). CurCousin® is a patented dietary ingredient that has been studied
in clinical research and is used in supplements to support healthy weight goals, healthy lipid
metabolism, and overall metabolic wellness.

[Citrin®]
[Citrin® Logo]

Citrin® is a globally recognized, scientifically studied, safe and natural ingredient derived from
the fruit rinds of *Garcinia cambogia*, traditionally known as ‘Indian Malabar Tamarind’.

[Boswellin®]
[Boswellin® Logo]

Boswellin^{®} is a premium standardized extract obtained from the gum resin of *Boswellia serrata*
(known as Frankincense or Olibanum). This extract contains key pentacyclic triterpenoids with a
standardized composition of 70% Boswellic Acids, 20% β Boswellic Acids, and 2%
Acetyl-11-keto-β-Boswellic acids (AKBBA).

[BioPerine®]
[BioPerine® Logo]

BioPerine® is a standardized extract, prepared from the dried fruits of *Piper nigrum* (black
pepper) and contains a minimum of 95% Piperine. It is the world’s safest, and the most clinically
studied black pepper extract used for over 35 years.

[Saberry®]
[Saberry® Logo]

Introducing **Saberry®**, a Multifaceted Super Fruit Extract derived from fresh, handpicked Amla
fruits, also known as Indian Gooseberry (*Emblica officinalis*). This unique extract is meticulously
standardized to contain a minimum of 10% β‐glucogallin, ensuring the highest quality and efficacy.

[Cirpusins]
[Cirpusins Logo]

Cirpusins® is the extract of *Cyperus rotundus* rhizomes standardized to contain Scirpusin A,
Scirpusin B, and Piceatannol amounting to 6% total Stilbenoids.

[Boswellin® Super]
[Boswellin® Super Logo]
[LivLonga®]
[LivLonga® Logo]

LivLonga® from Sabinsa is a US patented, unique blend of three scientifically validated natural
ingredients, including Curcumin C3 Complex® (*Curcuma longa *extract), Livinol® (*Garcinia indica
*extract), and the bioavailability enhancer BioPerine® (*Piper nigrum *extract), to support healthy
liver function.

## The Intersection of Research and Revolutionary Ideas

The R&D center is a true innovation epicenter, which focuses onfinding ways to constantly improve
productivity, cost reduction, quality, and new product development without sacrificing the science
behind its research. To achieve this, several independent divisions use a synergistic approach by
working together to profile the product, ensuring it meets international standards.

[Know More][45]

## Turning Ideas into Reality

With a combination of planning, action, and perseverance, we are turning ideas into reality.

[Know More][46]
01

### Research

Our R&D center drives improvements in productivity, cost reduction, and innovation.

02

### Manufacturing

Sabinsa manufactures its products as per global standards at its eight state-of-the-art
manufacturing facilities located in the US and India.

03

### Quality Control

Sabinsa operates its own quality control, investing in advanced analytical equipment, mass
spectrometry, & liquid chromatography analyzers.

04

### Success Story

For 37 years, Sabinsa has launched 130+ standardized botanical extracts and funded clinical studies
with top institutions to support these products.

05

### Global Presence

Sabinsa has a global presence with offices in the USA, Europe, Brazil, Japan, and India, serving
over 100 countries.

06

### Innovation

Sabinsa is committed to innovation, continuously developing new products and improving existing ones
to meet global health needs.

[Sustainability]

## Sustainability

Sabinsa has adopted four fundamental sustainability tenets.

**HUMAN SUSTAINABILITY:** Sabinsa is mindful of the well-being of its workforce and maximizing their
potential. The company strives to motivate its team to be resilient, inclusive and high-performing
at work.

[Know More][47]
[Dr. Muhammed Majeed]
[Sabinsa | Leading Standardized Herbal Extracts Manufacturer & Supplier]

## Founder's Desk

The Late Dr. Muhammed Majeed was born and raised in Kerala, India. He had over 45+ years of
experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, molecular biology, nutritional, and cosmetic
industries.

As a researcher, scientist, entrepreneur, and business leader, Dr. Majeed pioneered the development
of standardized herbal extracts from India’s Ayurvedic plants and created a global market for them.
He founded and, for 36 years, led Sabinsa into becoming a leading leading multinational health &
life sciences company.

[Know More][48]

## Global Presence

Sabinsa upholds a robust global presence, with offices and facilities across multiple continents to
serve clients in the health and nutrition industry.

[Fenumannan®]

### Fenumannan®

**Fenumannan®** is an extract derived from fenugreek seeds (*Trigonella foenum-graecum*),
standardized to contain not less than 60% galactomannans.

[Starmeric®]
[Starmeric® Logo]

Starmeric® is a resistant starch prepared from turmeric (*Curcuma longa)*, standardized to contain a
minimum of 20% and 35% of total starch.

[ZeaLutein®]
[ZeaLutein® Logo]

ZeaLutein® is a brick-red proprietary blend of naturally sourced 1% Zeaxanthin, 5% Lutein and 2%
Piperine derived from *Tagetes erecta* (marigold), and *Piper nigrum* (black pepper).

[Cococin®]
[Cococin® Logo]

Cococin® is a GRAS affirmed, freeze-dried ingredient from the liquid endosperm of fresh green
coconuts (*Cocos nucifera*).  In view of its inherent nutritional significance, it has been rightly
trademarked as “The Nourishment Factor®”, offering a valuable nutrient pool for enhancing food and
beverage formulations.

 

[Bacopin®]
[Bacopin® Logo]

**Bacopin®** is an extract prepared from the dried stems and leaves of *Bacopa monnieri*, a natural
herb traditionally used to support memory and cognitive health. It is standardized to contain
Bacosides, the key active compounds associated with its beneficial effects, to support healthy brain
function. Bacopin**®** is available in different strengths standardized to 20%, 40%, and 50%
Bacosides.

[GS<sub>4</sub> PLUS®]

### GS4 PLUS®

**GS4 PLUS®** is a branded extract derived from the leaves of the *Gymnema sylvestre* plant,
commonly known as “*Madhunashini*” or “*gurmar*“.
[Momordicin®]

### Momordicin®

**Momordicin®** is a branded extract derived from the deseeded fruits of *Momordica charantia*,
commonly known as bitter melon or bitter gourd. It is standardized to contain Bitter Principles and
Charantin (0.5%), a naturally occurring compound associated with glucose metabolism support.
[ForsLean®]
[ForsLean® Logo]
ForsLean^{®} is a patented, natural extract of the roots of *Coleus forskohlii*, standardized to
contain 10% Forskolin (20% and 40% strengths are also available). ForsLean^{®} is a clinically
studied supplement for supporting healthy body composition and metabolic wellness.
[Cinnasil®]

### Cinnasil®

Cinnasil® (*Cinnamomum cassia, *Cinnamon bark extract), standardized to 20% polyphenols, has been
studied in human research and helps support healthy blood sugar levels already within a normal
range.

[pTeroSol®]
[pTeroSol® Logo]
**pTeroSol^{®}**, a water-soluble, nature-inspired extract prepared from the heartwood of the Indian
Kino tree (*Pterocarpus marsupium*) standardized to contain a minimum of *5% C-glycosides* (as
*Pterocarposide and Sabioside*), has been clinically studied to help maintain healthy blood sugar
levels.
[DigeZyme®]
[DigeZyme® Logo]

DigeZyme® is a proprietary, patented and clinically studied multi-enzyme complex, containing five
digestive enzymes: amylase, protease, lipase, cellulase, and lactase.

[Livinol®]
[Livinol® Logo]

A patented extract derived from the dried fruit rinds of *Garcinia indica*, containing at least 20%
Garcinol, which supports energy balance, liver health, and supports healthy weight maintenance with
diet and exercise.

[Tinofolin®]
[Tinofolin® Logo]

Tinofolin**^{®}** is a natural nootropic adaptogen extracted from the aerial parts (stem and leaves)
of the plant *Tinospora cordifolia* (Guduchi), standardized to 2.5% Bitter Principles.

[Sabroxy®]
[Sabroxy® Logo]

A patent protected, clinically evaluated standardized extract prepared from the dried bark of the
Indian trumpet tree (*Oroxylum indicum*), containing a minimum of 10% Oroxylin A, 15% Baicalein, 6%
Chrysin. It helps to support healthy cognitive function, memory, concentration, focus and neuronal
functions.

[CurCousin®]
[CurCousin® Logo]

CurCousin® is a branded nutritional ingredient containing the bioactive Calebin A (analog of
Curcumin) with self-affirmed GRAS status. It is a curcumin analog naturally present in *Curcuma
longa / cassia* (Black Turmeric). CurCousin® is a patented dietary ingredient that has been studied
in clinical research and is used in supplements to support healthy weight goals, healthy lipid
metabolism, and overall metabolic wellness.

[Citrin®]
[Citrin® Logo]

Citrin® is a globally recognized, scientifically studied, safe and natural ingredient derived from
the fruit rinds of *Garcinia cambogia*, traditionally known as ‘Indian Malabar Tamarind’.

[Boswellin®]
[Boswellin® Logo]

Boswellin^{®} is a premium standardized extract obtained from the gum resin of *Boswellia serrata*
(known as Frankincense or Olibanum). This extract contains key pentacyclic triterpenoids with a
standardized composition of 70% Boswellic Acids, 20% β Boswellic Acids, and 2%
Acetyl-11-keto-β-Boswellic acids (AKBBA).

[BioPerine®]
[BioPerine® Logo]

BioPerine® is a standardized extract, prepared from the dried fruits of *Piper nigrum* (black
pepper) and contains a minimum of 95% Piperine. It is the world’s safest, and the most clinically
studied black pepper extract used for over 35 years.

[Saberry®]
[Saberry® Logo]

Introducing **Saberry®**, a Multifaceted Super Fruit Extract derived from fresh, handpicked Amla
fruits, also known as Indian Gooseberry (*Emblica officinalis*). This unique extract is meticulously
standardized to contain a minimum of 10% β‐glucogallin, ensuring the highest quality and efficacy.

[Cirpusins]
[Cirpusins Logo]

Cirpusins® is the extract of *Cyperus rotundus* rhizomes standardized to contain Scirpusin A,
Scirpusin B, and Piceatannol amounting to 6% total Stilbenoids.

[Boswellin® Super]
[Boswellin® Super Logo]
[LivLonga®]
[LivLonga® Logo]

LivLonga® from Sabinsa is a US patented, unique blend of three scientifically validated natural
ingredients, including Curcumin C3 Complex® (*Curcuma longa *extract), Livinol® (*Garcinia indica
*extract), and the bioavailability enhancer BioPerine® (*Piper nigrum *extract), to support healthy
liver function.

## Email Finder FAQ

If you can't find the answer to your question here, visit the dedicated section in our Help Center.

[Visit Help Center][32]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### Where does GetProspect find emails?

GetProspect Email finder uses its powerful database of over 200 million business contacts with
emails and 26 million companies to find email addresses, as well as LinkedIn's largest and most
current business contacts database with over 900 million users.

### How accurate is the Email Finder?

The accuracy of valid emails that were found on the platform is 95%.

According to the latest tests, GetProspect Email Finder found 84 valid email addresses out of 100
contacts, which is higher than in such alternatives as ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, Lusha, ContactOut, and
others.

### How can I extract an email address from a website?

The GetProspect company Email Finder extracts business email addresses from any company website.
Once the extension is installed, it can be used for fetching basic info about the companies,
employees' email addresses and getting essential data about them. Just click on the extension icon
to find emails and leads you need by name or job title.

### Is the Getprospect Email Finder a free service?

GetProspect Email Finder provides lifetime access to 50 free new email addresses each month.

### How much does the Email Finder cost?

Paid Email Finder subscriptions start at $49 per month with 1,000 valid emails and 2,000
verifications. You can find email addresses for just $34 per month with an annual payment. Find out
more about it at [Pricing.][33]

Hi, I’m Dima, founder and CEO at GetProspect.

The idea for GetProspect came after talking with a salesperson friend who struggled to find valid
emails. I realized that the process of finding and organizing leads was time-consuming and
frustrating, and there had to be a better way.

I had experience building SAAS tools and created MVP in just a couple of months. I worked so great,
and demand was so high that it grew very fast. Through hard work and dedication, GetProspect turned
into a successful company with customers all over the world.

We are building an all-in-one platform that will help businesses to find email addresses and leads,
send them, and close deals. Our goal is to build a great company with a startup culture where we are
happy to work and deliver outstanding services that customers will love. We rely on the latest
technologies and trends to bring  innovations to our users.

I hope you’ll feel our love through the product and it will bring true value.

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### Where does GetProspect find emails?

GetProspect Email finder uses its powerful database of over 200 million business contacts with
emails and 26 million companies to find email addresses, as well as LinkedIn's largest and most
current business contacts database with over 900 million users.

The accuracy of valid emails that were found on the platform is 95%.

contacts, which is higher than in such alternatives as ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, Lusha, ContactOut, and

### Live Healthy with Life Pharmacy – First Omni-Channel Pharmacy & Healthcare Retailer in Middle
### East.

Our Heritage:

Life Pharmacy started its journey in 1996 with a strong impulse to provide state-of-the-art
experience in healthcare retail. Starting with one store, Life Pharmacy in UAE has 600+ retail
outlets consisting of Pharmacies, Healthcare Hypermarkets, Health and Wellness stores catering to an
average annual customer base of more than ten million walk-ins. Life Pharmacy is also the number one
Online pharmacy in UAE. Life Pharmacy app and website are widely used by users across UAE for all
their health, fitness & lifestyle needs.



### USPs of Life Pharmacy
* Life Pharmacy Mobile App
* Available on Android and iOS App Store, Life Pharmacy app is a one stop destination for everything
  from vitamins to beauty care to sports nutrition to baby care products.
* Largest pharmacy network in UAE:
* Available on Android and iOS App Store, Life Pharmacy app is a one stop destination for everything
  from vitamins to beauty care to sports nutrition to baby care products.
* Omni-channel Experience:
* Life Pharmacy has successfully connected the world of online and offline with its innovative
  omni-channel retail technologies. Users can now shop wherever they choose, be it at one of our
  retail stores, call, or on their mobile devices.
* Widest range of products:
* Shop from a wide range of vitamins, sports supplements, beauty care products, makeup, baby care
  products and more at Life Pharmacy.
* Top Brands:
* Life Pharmacy brings all the top brands in healthcare, fitness, beauty & more. Shop Sunshine
  Nutrition, Trister, Cetaphil, Bioderma, Mustela, Sebamed, Solgar, and other brands on Life
  Pharmacy online.
* Free Delivery
* Free delivery is available on Life Pharmacy website and app on a large number of products.
* 30 minutes delivery
* Shop on Life Pharmacy app or website and get your products delivered in less than 30 minutes.
  Available on select range of products.
* Detailed information on products:
* Life Pharmacy provides users expert advice on products through a proper description of
  ingredients, usage etc.
* Value for money:
* The online pharmacy in UAE brings the best deals and biggest savings on the most sought after
  brands.
* Easy Payment Options:
* Shop using your credit or debit cards. Or add to your wallet and save big.

### Achievements & Awards

At LIFE Pharmacy, our journey of innovation, service, and growth has earned us some of the most
prestigious accolades in the region:

The method of solvent extraction uses a separation solvent, which is generally non-volatile has a

Supercritical fluid extraction is an efficient separation method of active ingredients from plant

CO2.

### FAQs


#### What is the best natural source of vitamin E?

Vegetable oils like sunflower and soy as well as rapeseed are excellent sources of natural vitamin
E. This is because they contain high levels of d-alpha tocopherol.

#### How to check if vitamin E is natural or synthetic?

You should look at the label for the 'd-' prefix for natural vitamin E. Note that the synthetic
versions use the 'dl' prefix.

#### What certifications do you hold?

Matrix Life Science holds several international certifications, including ISO 22000, KOSHER, HALAL,
and FSSC 22000.

#### Is your Natural Vitamin E Non-GMO and Organic certified?

Our ingredients come from 100% non-GMO sources. We offer organic certified options to meet your
specific clean label requirements.

#### Does Matrix Life Science offer both Oil and Powder forms of Vitamin E?

We offer oil as well as powder formats to ensure the ingredients work perfectly in your products.

#### Can Matrix Life Science handle bulk supply for global manufacturers?

Our massive 80,000-square-meter facility allows us to manage bulk orders easily for the largest
global manufacturers.

####  Why is Matrix Life Science considered one of the top Naturall-E producers?

Matrix Life Science is a renowned brand, known as a trusted Naturall-E manufacturer, producing in
India with global presence. Our core expertise lies in the extraction of plant based Natural
Tocopherols (Vitamin E) sourced from 100% Non-GMO Soy, Sunflower, and Rapeseed. Our technologically
advanced manufacturing plant is spread across more than 80, 000 sq. meters and subsidiaries in USA,
Europe, and South America. Our clientele bases are the global industries of food, dietary
supplement, animal nutrition. pharmaceuticals, and cosmetics.

#### What separates Naturall-E from synthetic Vitamin E?

Naturall-E (d-Alpha tocopherol) is derived from natural sources such as soybean, sunflower, and
rapeseed oils. Naturall-E offers superior bioavailability compared to synthetic Vitamin E (dl-alpha
tocopherol), enabling more efficient absorption and retention in the human body.. Being Naturall-E
producers only, Matrix Life Science generates solely plant, derived tocopherols, which allows us to
offer a cleaner, more potent, and sustainable ingredient for your products.

#### What are the sources that Matrix Life Science uses to make Naturall-E?

 Matrix Life Science Extracts Naturall-E (Tocopherols) only from 100% Non, GMO plant sources, such
as :
* Soybean oil
* Sunflower oil
* Rapeseed oil

This guarantees that our customers in various industries receive the highest purity, quality, and
traceability.

#### What are the wide applications of Matrix’s Products across industries?

 Being eminent Vitamin E producers, we supply our Natural Tocopherols to a broad spectrum of
industries:

**Food & Beverages -** as a natural antioxidant to help prolong the shelf life.
**Human Nutrition & Nutraceuticals –** soft gel capsules, tablets, gummies nutritional drinks and
beverages.
**Cosmetics & Personal Care –** Hair and skin protection and anti-aging product formulations.
**Pharmaceuticals –** API carrier and tablets.
**Animal Nutrition –** Vitamin E premix, Feed and food formulation.

#### Is the Naturall-E produced by Matrix Life Science certified?

Absolutely. Matrix Life Science is certified for several areas including system, community, and
application standards. Our certifications are a proof of quality, safety, and compliance of our
Naturall-E products for the global markets. Do have a look at our Certifications page to know more
about our current certifications.

#### What Vitamin E products and brands does Matrix Life Science have?

Matrix Life Science offers a full range of Naturall-E products under the Naturalle, E brand. Our
extensive range comprises mixed tocopherols, d-Alpha tocopherols, for food preservation,
nutraceutical supplementation, and cosmetic applications. Also, we supply Toco feed our specialized
tocopherol product line for animal nutrition.

### Our Story

### Leading Natural Vitamin E Producers for Global Health Brands

Matrix Life Science leads the industry as one of the most reliable natural vitamin E producers
globally. We provide high-quality tocopherols and phytosterols from 100% non GMO sources to help
brands create better products for their customers. We maintain high quality standards while ensuring
every ingredient retains its natural integrity.

#### Why Your Brand Needs Premium Vitamin E?

Selecting the right ingredients means looking for sources that your consumers can trust without
hesitation. We offer Natural Vitamin E that provides superior bioavailability compared to the
synthetic versions often found in cheaper supplements.

**Matrix Life Science** understands that modern consumers are reading labels more carefully than
ever before. You want to give them the best possible version of this nutrient so they feel the
difference.

#### Our Diverse Range of Plant-Based Ingredients

We provide a wide variety of concentrations and forms of Natural Vitamin E to suit different
manufacturing needs.
* Non-GMO mixed tocopherols that offer excellent antioxidant properties for preserving food and skin
  products for a longer periods.
* High-concentration D-Alpha tocopherol, which acts as a powerful nutrient for daily health
  supplements and wellness products.
* Natural phytosterols sourced responsibly to support heart health and cholesterol management
  initiatives worldwide.
* Water-dispersible powders as well as oil-based solutions that integrate into your existing
  production lines.

#### Optimising Production with Experienced Vitamin E Producers

As one of the top Vitamin E manufacturers, Matrix Life Science operates a world-class facility
spread across 80,000 square meters. With one of the largest installed production capacities in
India, we are well-positioned to serve the evolving needs of international markets with consistency
and scale.

We manage the entire process under one roof. Our infrastructure allows us to stay ahead of the
competition without compromising on environmental standards.

#### Benefits of Choosing Non-GMO Sources
* Full traceability of raw materials verifies that each batch meets the strict safety requirements.
* Better consumer perception leads to higher brand loyalty as well as trust in your finished product
  range.
* Avoiding synthetic additives helps maintain the organic profile that numerous modern shoppers
  prefer.

#### Global Reach and Technical Support from Matrix Life Science

With a well-established presence across multiple continents, we support global businesses with
consistent and dependable ingredient supply. As trusted Vitamin E manufacturers, we emphasize
technical expertise and customer-centricity. Our advanced logistics network ensures every order is
delivered efficiently and on time.

#### Partner with the Leading Vitamin E Producers

Contact Matrix Life Science today to discuss how our natural vitamin E producers status can help you
achieve your production goals. We are ready to provide the superior ingredients and bulk supply
solutions your company needs.

### FAQs


#### What is the best natural source of vitamin E?

Vegetable oils like sunflower and soy as well as rapeseed are excellent sources of natural vitamin
E. This is because they contain high levels of d-alpha tocopherol.

#### How to check if vitamin E is natural or synthetic?

You should look at the label for the 'd-' prefix for natural vitamin E. Note that the synthetic
versions use the 'dl' prefix.

#### What certifications do you hold?

Matrix Life Science holds several international certifications, including ISO 22000, KOSHER, HALAL,
and FSSC 22000.

#### Is your Natural Vitamin E Non-GMO and Organic certified?

Our ingredients come from 100% non-GMO sources. We offer organic certified options to meet your
specific clean label requirements.

#### Does Matrix Life Science offer both Oil and Powder forms of Vitamin E?

We offer oil as well as powder formats to ensure the ingredients work perfectly in your products.

#### Can Matrix Life Science handle bulk supply for global manufacturers?

Our massive 80,000-square-meter facility allows us to manage bulk orders easily for the largest
global manufacturers.

####  Why is Matrix Life Science considered one of the top Naturall-E producers?

Matrix Life Science is a renowned brand, known as a trusted Naturall-E manufacturer, producing in
India with global presence. Our core expertise lies in the extraction of plant based Natural
Tocopherols (Vitamin E) sourced from 100% Non-GMO Soy, Sunflower, and Rapeseed. Our technologically
advanced manufacturing plant is spread across more than 80, 000 sq. meters and subsidiaries in USA,
Europe, and South America. Our clientele bases are the global industries of food, dietary
supplement, animal nutrition. pharmaceuticals, and cosmetics.

#### What separates Naturall-E from synthetic Vitamin E?

Naturall-E (d-Alpha tocopherol) is derived from natural sources such as soybean, sunflower, and
rapeseed oils. Naturall-E offers superior bioavailability compared to synthetic Vitamin E (dl-alpha
tocopherol), enabling more efficient absorption and retention in the human body.. Being Naturall-E
producers only, Matrix Life Science generates solely plant, derived tocopherols, which allows us to
offer a cleaner, more potent, and sustainable ingredient for your products.

#### What are the sources that Matrix Life Science uses to make Naturall-E?

 Matrix Life Science Extracts Naturall-E (Tocopherols) only from 100% Non, GMO plant sources, such
as :
* Soybean oil
* Sunflower oil
* Rapeseed oil

This guarantees that our customers in various industries receive the highest purity, quality, and
traceability.

#### What are the wide applications of Matrix’s Products across industries?

 Being eminent Vitamin E producers, we supply our Natural Tocopherols to a broad spectrum of
industries:

**Food & Beverages -** as a natural antioxidant to help prolong the shelf life.
**Human Nutrition & Nutraceuticals –** soft gel capsules, tablets, gummies nutritional drinks and
beverages.
**Cosmetics & Personal Care –** Hair and skin protection and anti-aging product formulations.
**Pharmaceuticals –** API carrier and tablets.
**Animal Nutrition –** Vitamin E premix, Feed and food formulation.

#### Is the Naturall-E produced by Matrix Life Science certified?

Absolutely. Matrix Life Science is certified for several areas including system, community, and
application standards. Our certifications are a proof of quality, safety, and compliance of our
Naturall-E products for the global markets. Do have a look at our Certifications page to know more
about our current certifications.

#### What Vitamin E products and brands does Matrix Life Science have?

Matrix Life Science offers a full range of Naturall-E products under the Naturalle, E brand. Our
extensive range comprises mixed tocopherols, d-Alpha tocopherols, for food preservation,
nutraceutical supplementation, and cosmetic applications. Also, we supply Toco feed our specialized
tocopherol product line for animal nutrition.

Q： What is Antioxidant 168, which industries primarily use it, and what are the key performance and
compliance requirements expected by consumers?


A： Antioxidant 168 is a high-efficiency, non-polluting phosphite antioxidant widely used to enhance
thermal and processing stability in plastics, rubber, and petroleum-based materials. Its major
end-use industries include automotive, construction, and packaging. Consumers generally prefer
Antioxidant 168 products that offer high performance, environmental sustainability, and compliance
with relevant regulatory standards.
Q： What is the current market size of Antioxidant 168, what are the key factors driving its growth,
and how do regional market trends differ globally?


A： The global Antioxidant 168 market was valued at approximately USD 1.2 billion in 2024 and is
projected to reach around USD 2.5 billion by 2033, growing at a CAGR of about 8.5%. Market growth is
primarily driven by increasing demand for high-quality plastics and rubber products, particularly in
packaging, automotive, and construction applications, as well as the need for longer-lasting
materials. Regionally, Asia-Pacific is expected to experience the fastest growth, followed by North
America and Europe.
Q： What challenges does the Antioxidant 168 market face, who are the major players, and how do
global trade dynamics impact market development?


A： The Antioxidant 168 market faces challenges such as fluctuations in raw material prices and
uncertainties arising from changes in global trade and tax policies. Major market participants
include BASF, SONGWON, Rianlon Corporation, UniteChem Group, Beijing Jiyi Holdings Group, Everlight
Chemical, and Yingkou Fengguang Advanced Material, among others. In addition, global trade
dynamics—such as import-export trends, tariffs, and trade agreements—play a significant role in
shaping supply chains, pricing, and regional market competitiveness.

Owler's exclusive company and industry insights make it easy to find competitors, leads, and
up-to-date news – so you can optimize your prospecting and sales results.

## For business professionals who want a serious competitive advantage

Owler Pro gives you access to premium features that keep your business in the loop about relevant
company, competitor, and industry news – so you can find qualified leads, improve your outreach, and
build better relationships with your customers.

**Follow an unlimited amount of companies relevant to your business needs**

**Discover new accounts, industry trends, and more**

**Get the latest news updates to stay ahead**

## For people who want an easier way to follow up to 5 companies that matter to them

Join Owler’s active community of 5 million+ business professionals and get exclusive insights about
competitors, prospects, and market updates that are only available to Owler users – so you can
ensure you stay ahead of the competition.

**Find detailed company information**

**Discover your closest competitors**

**Get real-time alerts and daily emails about relevant company and market news**

[ Learn about Owler Community ][64]

## What makes Owler different?

Discover your direct and indirect competitors with Owler's exclusive competitor graph.

Search accurate private and public company data for over 20 million companies.

Create targeted lists to get daily, personalized emails and alerts about news and companies that
matter to you.

Access detailed company data, including revenue, employee count, funding history, acquisitions,
news, and more.

Filter Owler’s entire database by revenue, sector, location, employee count, and public/private
company status.

# Emotive.
# Demand both.

From automotive and aerospace to coil and specialty, we engineer coatings and surface solutions that
protect and inspire.

[ About us ][60]

## Over 130 years of expertise. A new beginning.

We are Surventis - formerly known as BASF Coatings - a global leader in automotive coatings and
surface treatment. Following the agreement between BASF and Carlyle, we have become an independent,
standalone company: a new identity, built on continuity.

Our new chapter builds on the foundations that have made us strong: deep technical expertise,
long-standing customer relationships, trusted heritage brands, and a culture shaped over more than
130 years. As an independent company, we now move with greater entrepreneurial freedom, faster
decision-making and agility, backed by Carlyle's global network and commitment to our growth.

[ Press Release ][62]

## What defines us

Our intelligent coatings help customers shine in their markets. We anticipate global trends and
identify opportunities that shape the future of industries. We meet the highest technical and
quality demands in an aesthetically pleasing, environmentally friendly way, combining design with
functionality. Our work in research, production and service is reliable worldwide.

### Driven by passion and science

Built on BASF's heritage with a more entrepreneurial future, we foster an inspiring exchange across
diverse perspectives.

[ Careers ][64]

### Merging science and beauty

Close collaboration, global presence, expertise and innovation are the pillars of our commercial
success.

### Reliable worldwide

Around 10,000 employees at our more than 70 sites of Surventis are ready to serve, wherever you are
located.

We engineer coatings and surface solutions, from treatment to refinish, across automotive and many
other industries. Working with us means going further to solve even your most challenging needs.

Our solutions support a broad range of vehicle categories and powertrain concepts, helping
manufacturers, suppliers, body builders and bodyshops create the surfaces that keep the automotive
world moving.

With decades of aerospace experience and a broad portfolio of OEM approved technologies, we support
a wide range of aircraft types and applications.
[Learn more][70]
[
Image
[detail of steel coils in warehouse] ][71]

### Coil

We support the coil industry with surface treatment and advanced application technologies that
prepare and protect metal before it is shaped and coated.
[Learn more][72]
[
Image

### Specialty

From a perfectly smooth piano finish to precise optical components and durable motorcycle surfaces,
we help each surface perform as intended in its own context.

### Refinity® – a seamless digital experience for bodyshops

Our cloud-based platform brings together a full suite of digital solutions for automotive refinish,
helping body shops worldwide work faster, more sustainably and with the most advanced digital color
experience available.
[Discover Refinity®][76]
[
Image
[Tesseract blue] ][77]

### Automotive Color Trends – DRIVING THE PROXY

Each year our designers shape the colors of tomorrow's vehicles. Our latest collection draws on
design, nature and technology, with sustainable materials and innovations like multi-color pigments
and liquid-metal surfaces.
[Explore the collection][78]
[
Image
[Automotive color display] ][79]

### The world's largest color databases

Decades of color expertise, captured in one of the world's largest databases. It lets us match and
reproduce virtually any shade with precision, whether designing tomorrow's vehicles or restoring
today's.
[Our color expertise][80]
[
Image

### Trusted heritage brands

Behind Surventis stands a portfolio of brands the industry has relied on for generations. Glasurit®,
with over 130 years of refinish expertise, and R-M®, with more than a century of color leadership,
are recognized by bodyshops and manufacturers worldwide, alongside specialist brands like baslac®
and Norbin®. These names carry a legacy of quality that continues into our new chapter.

### [ Surventis launches as an independent global leader in automotive coatings and surface
### treatment ][84]

MUENSTER, Germany, July 1, 2026. Surventis, formerly BASF Coatings, today launched as an independent
company, completing its carve-out from BASF. With around €3.9 billion in annual sales and around
10,700 employees, Surventis is one of the world’s leading suppliers of automotive coatings and
surface treatment solutions. The business is majority-owned by funds managed by global investment
firm Carlyle (NASDAQ: CG) in partnership with Qatar Investment Authority. BASF holds a 40% stake in
Surventis.
Jul 1, 2026
[[Image of the executive committee of Surventis] ][85]

### [ BASF Coatings names Executive Committee to lead and drive success as a standalone company
### ][86]

MUENSTER, Germany, June 25, 2026. BASF Coatings today named the leadership team that will run the
business as an independent company from July 1, 2026, after the closing of the transaction. The new
structure brings together leaders who have built the coatings business over many years and senior
executives with proven records in finance, digital and transformation. The Executive Committee will
be led by incoming Chief Executive Officer Jens Luehring.

We are Surventis - formerly known as BASF Coatings - a global leader in automotive coatings and
surface treatment. Following the agreement between BASF and Carlyle, we have become an independent,
standalone company: a new identity, built on continuity.

Our new chapter builds on the foundations that have made us strong: deep technical expertise,
long-standing customer relationships, trusted heritage brands, and a culture shaped over more than
130 years. As an independent company, we now move with greater entrepreneurial freedom, faster
decision-making and agility, backed by Carlyle's global network and commitment to our growth.

  Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) have been conducted to evaluate treatment efficacy for
  metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) and metabolic
  dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis. This study aimed to compare the effectiveness and safety
  of 11 promising targets among adults with MASLD.
  
  PubMed, Web of Science, the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, Scopus, and Embase
  were searched from inception to November 20, 2024. The primary outcomes were fibrosis improvement
  ≥1 stage without worsening of steatohepatitis and steatohepatitis resolution without worsening of
  fibrosis. Additional outcomes included reductions in liver fat content, liver enzymes, metabolic
  profiles, and selected safety outcomes. The surface under the cumulative ranking curve (SUCRA) was
  used to rank efficacy.
  
  Of 11,584 articles screened, 44 eligible RCTs (11,410 participants, 33 medications) were included.
  For fibrosis improvement, d-(R)-pioglitazone (SUCRA: 79.3) and fibroblast growth factor (FGF) 21
  analogs (SUCRA: 71.9) ranked higher. For steatohepatitis resolution, glucagon-like peptide-1
  (GLP-1)/glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) dual receptor agonists (RAs) (SUCRA:
  91.7) ranked higher. Co-agonists of GLP-1/GIP/GCG and GLP-1/GCG receptors ranked higher for
  relative and absolute changes in liver fat content, respectively. For liver enzymes and glucose
  improvement, the combination of a GLP-1 RA and an acetyl-coenzyme A carboxylase inhibitor ranked
  higher. GLP-1 RAs, peroxisome proliferator-activated RAs, and FGF21 analogs showed favorable
  effects on lipid profile improvement.
  
  Incretin-based co-agonists and FGF21 analogs showed favorable profiles across key endpoints, while
  d-(R)-pioglitazone and GLP-1/GIP dual RAs ranked higher for fibrosis improvement and
  steatohepatitis resolution, respectively. SUCRA rankings should be interpreted in conjunction with
  effect sizes, uncertainty, and available safety data.

  doi:[10.14218/JCTH.2026.00024][43]
  [ **Abstract ** ][44]
  Hepatic sinusoidal obstruction syndrome (HSOS) is a life-threatening liver vascular disorder with

  Hepatic sinusoidal obstruction syndrome (HSOS) is a life-threatening liver vascular disorder with
  limited treatment options. HSOS results from the activation and injury of liver sinusoidal
  endothelial cells (LSECs). Berberine (BBR) has been shown to protect endothelial cells in various
  diseases. However, whether BBR can alleviate liver injury and LSEC disruption in HSOS remains
  unclear. In this study, we aimed to evaluate the effect of BBR on HSOS.
  
  Two mouse models of HSOS were established using monocrotaline or oxaliplatin. Mice in the
  treatment groups received a low dose (100 mg/kg) or a high dose (200 mg/kg) of BBR daily.
  Histology, scanning electron microscopy, immunofluorescence, and flow cytometry were used to
  evaluate the therapeutic effects of BBR. Cell co-culture, Transwell assays, qRT-PCR, and Western
  blotting were performed to investigate the molecular pathways involved.
  
  BBR treatment dose-dependently reduced liver injury and disruption of LSECs in murine HSOS models.
  Moreover, BBR significantly reduced hepatic neutrophil infiltration, thereby attenuating
  neutrophil-mediated injury to LSECs. Additionally, BBR inhibited the effect of injured LSECs on
  neutrophil activation. Mechanistically, injured LSECs were identified as one of the major sources
  of CXCL1 in HSOS, and BBR downregulated CXCL1 expression in injured LSECs by inhibiting MAPK
  signaling.
  
  In this study, we demonstrate that BBR ameliorates HSOS by inhibiting endothelial-mediated
  neutrophil recruitment and activation. BBR may be a promising therapeutic option for HSOS
  treatment.

  The impact of baseline liver fibrosis severity on the effectiveness of pegylated interferon
  (Peg-IFN) combined with nucleos(t)ide analogs (NAs) in the treatment of hepatitis B e antigen
  (HBeAg)-positive chronic hepatitis B (CHB) has not been fully clarified. This study aimed to
  investigate whether the effectiveness of this combination therapy differed according to the
  severity of baseline liver fibrosis.
  
  A total of 172 HBeAg-positive CHB patients receiving Peg-IFN plus NAs were stratified according to
  non-invasive fibrosis markers (aspartate aminotransferase-to-platelet ratio index [APRI] and
  fibrosis-4 index [FIB-4]) into three groups: no significant fibrosis (n = 75), significant
  fibrosis (n = 70), and advanced fibrosis/cirrhosis (n = 27). The primary outcome was the HBeAg
  clearance rate at 24 months of treatment. Secondary outcomes included the hepatitis B surface
  antigen (HBsAg) clearance rate, the rate of HBsAg level decline > 1.0 log10, virological response,

  Hepatic sinusoidal obstruction syndrome (HSOS) is a life-threatening liver vascular disorder with
  limited treatment options. HSOS results from the activation and injury of liver sinusoidal
  endothelial cells (LSECs). Berberine (BBR) has been shown to protect endothelial cells in various
  diseases. However, whether BBR can alleviate liver injury and LSEC disruption in HSOS remains
  unclear. In this study, we aimed to evaluate the effect of BBR on HSOS.
  
  Two mouse models of HSOS were established using monocrotaline or oxaliplatin. Mice in the
  treatment groups received a low dose (100 mg/kg) or a high dose (200 mg/kg) of BBR daily.
  Histology, scanning electron microscopy, immunofluorescence, and flow cytometry were used to
  evaluate the therapeutic effects of BBR. Cell co-culture, Transwell assays, qRT-PCR, and Western
  blotting were performed to investigate the molecular pathways involved.
  
  BBR treatment dose-dependently reduced liver injury and disruption of LSECs in murine HSOS models.
  Moreover, BBR significantly reduced hepatic neutrophil infiltration, thereby attenuating
  neutrophil-mediated injury to LSECs. Additionally, BBR inhibited the effect of injured LSECs on
  neutrophil activation. Mechanistically, injured LSECs were identified as one of the major sources
  of CXCL1 in HSOS, and BBR downregulated CXCL1 expression in injured LSECs by inhibiting MAPK
  signaling.
  
  In this study, we demonstrate that BBR ameliorates HSOS by inhibiting endothelial-mediated
  neutrophil recruitment and activation. BBR may be a promising therapeutic option for HSOS
  treatment.
